//| label: fig-Trees_Expanded
//| fig-cap: An expanded decision tree for predicting house prices. The root node splits on living area, and the "Large house" node further splits based on the number of bathrooms.
//| fig-height: 4
digraph DecisionTree {
  rankdir = TB
  nodesep = 0.8
  ranksep = 1.0
  bgcolor = "transparent"
  node [fontname = "Helvetica", fontsize = 12, penwidth = 1.8]
  edge [penwidth = 1.4, fontname = "Helvetica", fontsize = 10]

  // Root node (decision)
  Root [
    label = <<TABLE BORDER="0" CELLBORDER="0" CELLSPACING="2">
      <TR><TD><B>Living Area</B></TD></TR>
      <TR><TD>&gt; 150 m²?</TD></TR>
    </TABLE>>
    shape = diamond
    width = 2.2
    height = 1.4
    style = "filled,rounded"
    fillcolor = "#DCEEFB"
    color = "#2B7BB9"
  ]

  // Left leaf (small house)
  Left [
    label = <<TABLE BORDER="0" CELLBORDER="0" CELLSPACING="2">
      <TR><TD><B>1.4M DKK</B></TD></TR>
      <TR><TD><FONT POINT-SIZE="9" COLOR="#555555">Small house</FONT></TD></TR>
    </TABLE>>
    shape = box
    style = "filled,rounded"
    fillcolor = "#E3F2E1"
    color = "#3A8A3A"
    width = 1.6
  ]

  // Second decision node (bathrooms)
  Bathrooms [
    label = <<TABLE BORDER="0" CELLBORDER="0" CELLSPACING="2">
      <TR><TD><B>Bathrooms</B></TD></TR>
      <TR><TD>How many?</TD></TR>
    </TABLE>>
    shape = diamond
    width = 2.0
    height = 1.3
    style = "filled,rounded"
    fillcolor = "#DCEEFB"
    color = "#2B7BB9"
  ]

  // Bathroom leaf nodes
  Bath1 [
    label = <<TABLE BORDER="0" CELLBORDER="0" CELLSPACING="2">
      <TR><TD><B>2.0M DKK</B></TD></TR>
      <TR><TD><FONT POINT-SIZE="9" COLOR="#555555">1 bathroom</FONT></TD></TR>
    </TABLE>>
    shape = box
    style = "filled,rounded"
    fillcolor = "#E3F2E1"
    color = "#3A8A3A"
    width = 1.6
  ]

  Bath2 [
    label = <<TABLE BORDER="0" CELLBORDER="0" CELLSPACING="2">
      <TR><TD><B>2.4M DKK</B></TD></TR>
      <TR><TD><FONT POINT-SIZE="9" COLOR="#555555">2 bathrooms</FONT></TD></TR>
    </TABLE>>
    shape = box
    style = "filled,rounded"
    fillcolor = "#E3F2E1"
    color = "#3A8A3A"
    width = 1.6
  ]

  Bath3 [
    label = <<TABLE BORDER="0" CELLBORDER="0" CELLSPACING="2">
      <TR><TD><B>2.8M DKK</B></TD></TR>
      <TR><TD><FONT POINT-SIZE="9" COLOR="#555555">3 bathrooms</FONT></TD></TR>
    </TABLE>>
    shape = box
    style = "filled,rounded"
    fillcolor = "#E3F2E1"
    color = "#3A8A3A"
    width = 1.6
  ]

  // Edges
  Root -> Left      [label = <<FONT COLOR="#C0392B">No</FONT>>, color = "#C0392B"]
  Root -> Bathrooms [label = <<FONT COLOR="#27AE60">Yes</FONT>>, color = "#27AE60"]
  Bathrooms -> Bath1 [label = <<FONT COLOR="#555555"> 1 </FONT>>, color = "#555555", labeldistance = 2.0, minlen = 2]
  Bathrooms -> Bath2 [label = <<FONT COLOR="#555555"> 2 </FONT>>, color = "#555555", labeldistance = 2.0, minlen = 2]
  Bathrooms -> Bath3 [label = <<FONT COLOR="#555555"> 3 </FONT>>, color = "#555555", labeldistance = 2.0, minlen = 2]
}
